exercises.name: Air Squat
exercises.description: Sit your hips back and down until thighs are level, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend near 90°, then return.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.description: Drop into a squat and drive up into a jump, landing softly back into the squat.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: From a high plank, lower your chest toward the floor and press back up.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Up
exercises.description: A push-up with hands set wider than shoulders to load the chest more.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.description: With hips high, bend the elbows to bring your head toward the floor, then press up.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: Lying face down, lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor together.

exercises.name: Prone Y-Raise
exercises.description: Face down with arms in a Y, lift the arms by squeezing the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercises.description: Face down, sweep straight arms from overhead to your hips without touching the floor.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: On your back with knees bent, curl your shoulders off the floor and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.description: From a high plank, drive knees toward the chest one at a time at pace.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and squat between your knees.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: With soft knees, push the hips back and lower the weights along your legs, then stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Hold weights at your sides and step back into a lunge.

exercises.name: Floor Press
exercises.description: Lying on your back, press the dumbbells from chest height to straight arms.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: From shoulder height, press the dumbbells straight overhead.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.description: Lift straight arms forward to shoulder height and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row
exercises.description: Hinge forward and pull the dumbbells toward your hips.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.description: Keeping elbows at your sides, curl the weights to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.description: Pull the dumbbells up along your body to chest height, elbows leading.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Seated and leaning back, rotate a dumbbell from hip to hip.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and crunch up.

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold
exercises.description: Stand tall holding a heavy dumbbell in one hand without leaning.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.description: Hinge and hike the bell back, then snap the hips forward to float it to chest height.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold the bell by the horns at your chest and squat deep.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Carry the bell at your side or chest and step back into a lunge.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Press
exercises.description: From the rack position, press the bell overhead and lock out.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.description: Lying down, press the bell from chest to straight arm.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Thruster
exercises.description: Squat with the bell racked, then stand and press it overhead in one motion.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Row
exercises.description: Hinged forward, pull the bell to your hip and lower it.

exercises.name: High Pull
exercises.description: Hinge, then extend hard and pull the bell up to chest height, elbows high.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
exercises.description: With the bell between your feet, hinge down, grip, and stand tall.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
exercises.description: Seated with feet down or up, rotate the bell side to side.

exercises.name: Halo
exercises.description: Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.

exercises.name: Farmer Hold
exercises.description: Stand or walk tall holding bells at your sides.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: With the bar across your upper back, squat to depth and stand.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: Rack the bar on your front shoulders and squat upright.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.description: With the bar on your back, step back into a lunge and return.

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Press
exercises.description: Lying down, lower the bar until elbows touch the floor, then press.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.description: From the front rack, press the bar overhead, moving your head back then through.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.description: Dip slightly at the knees, then drive the bar overhead with your legs.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Grip the bar over mid-foot and stand up by pushing through the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.description: Hinged forward, row the bar to your lower ribs.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Curl the bar from thighs to shoulders with elbows pinned.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout
exercises.description: From your knees, roll the bar forward as far as you can control, then pull back.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.description: With the bar on your back, hinge forward to near parallel and stand.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.description: With the bar across your hips, drive them up until level with your knees.

exercises.name: Banded Squat
exercises.description: Stand on the band with handles at shoulders and squat.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.description: With a loop above the knees, bridge up while pressing the knees out.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.description: In a half squat with a loop around the legs, step sideways without letting the feet meet.

exercises.name: Band Chest Press
exercises.description: With the band anchored behind, press both hands forward to straight arms.

exercises.name: Band Overhead Press
exercises.description: Stand on the band and press the handles overhead.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.description: With the band anchored high, push the hands down until elbows straighten.

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.description: With the band anchored in front, pull the handles to your ribs.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.description: Hold the band at shoulder height and pull it apart until it touches your chest.

exercises.name: Band Curl
exercises.description: Stand on the band and curl the handles up.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.description: With the band anchored to your side, press the hands straight out and resist the twist.

exercises.name: Band Woodchop
exercises.description: Pull the band diagonally from high to low across your body.

exercises.name: Banded Dead Bug
exercises.description: On your back holding a band anchored overhead, lower opposite arm and leg.

exercises.name: Ball Wall Squat
exercises.description: With a ball between your back and a wall, roll down into a squat and up.

exercises.name: Ball Hamstring Curl
exercises.description: Heels on the ball and hips lifted, roll the ball toward you and back out.

exercises.name: Ball Bridge
exercises.description: Feet on the ball, lift your hips into a straight line.

exercises.name: Incline Ball Push-Up
exercises.description: Hands on the ball, lower your chest to it and press away.

exercises.name: Decline Ball Push-Up
exercises.description: Shins on the ball and hands on the floor, perform push-ups.

exercises.name: Ball Pike
exercises.description: Feet on the ball in a plank, lift your hips high and roll back out.

exercises.name: Ball Back Extension
exercises.description: Draped face down over the ball, lift your chest until your body is straight.

exercises.name: Ball Y-Raise
exercises.description: Face down over the ball, raise your arms into a Y.

exercises.name: Ball Superman Hold
exercises.description: Over the ball, hold your chest and arms lifted.

exercises.name: Ball Crunch
exercises.description: With your low back on the ball, curl your ribs toward your hips.

exercises.name: Ball Plank
exercises.description: Forearms on the ball, hold a straight plank.

exercises.name: Ball Pass
exercises.description: Lying on your back, pass the ball from hands to feet and back.

exercises.name: Suspension Squat
exercises.description: Hold the handles for balance and squat deep.

exercises.name: Suspension Lunge
exercises.description: Holding the handles, step back into a lunge.

exercises.name: Suspension Hamstring Curl
exercises.description: Heels in the cradles, lift your hips and pull heels toward you.

exercises.name: Suspension Chest Press
exercises.description: Facing away and leaning forward, lower your chest between the handles and press back.

exercises.name: Suspension Triceps Extension
exercises.description: Leaning forward, bend only at the elbows to bring hands by your head, then extend.

exercises.name: Suspension Push-Up
exercises.description: Feet in the cradles, perform push-ups from the floor.

exercises.name: Suspension Row
exercises.description: Lean back with straight arms and pull your chest to the handles.

exercises.name: Suspension Y-Fly
exercises.description: Leaning back, raise straight arms up into a Y and pull yourself upright.

exercises.name: Suspension Biceps Curl
exercises.description: Leaning back with palms up, curl your hands toward your forehead.

exercises.name: Suspension Plank
exercises.description: Feet in the cradles, hold a straight high plank.

exercises.name: Suspension Knee Tuck
exercises.description: From a strap plank, pull both knees toward your chest.

exercises.name: Suspension Pike
exercises.description: From a strap plank, lift your hips high with straight legs.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.description: Hold one ankle behind you and bring the knee under your hip.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
exercises.description: Sit with legs long and fold forward from the hips.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: In a half kneel, shift your hips forward until the front of the back hip opens.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.description: On hands and knees, alternate rounding and arching your spine.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Chest
exercises.description: On your back, hug one knee toward your chest.

exercises.name: Supine Twist
exercises.description: On your back, let both knees fall to one side and look the other way.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.description: Pull one straight arm across your chest.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
exercises.description: Reach one hand down your back and ease the elbow back with the other hand.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.description: With forearm on a doorframe, step through until the chest opens.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
exercises.description: Hands on a wall, step one foot back and press the heel down.

exercises.name: Standing Toe Reach
exercises.description: Fold forward from the hips and let your hands hang toward your feet.

exercises.name: Front Leg Swing
exercises.description: Holding support, swing one leg forward and back in a relaxed arc.

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.description: Wide lunge with the front knee bent and arms reaching long both ways.

exercises.name: Low Lunge
exercises.description: Back knee down, sink the hips forward and lift the arms.

exercises.name: Chair Pose
exercises.description: Sit the hips back with arms raised as if lowering onto a chair.

exercises.name: Cobra
exercises.description: Face down, press lightly through the hands to lift the chest.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.description: Kneel, sit back toward your heels, and rest the forehead down with arms long.

exercises.name: Bridge Pose
exercises.description: On your back, press through the feet to lift the hips.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.description: Hands and feet down, lift the hips high to form an inverted V.

exercises.name: Upward Salute
exercises.description: Standing tall, sweep the arms overhead.

exercises.name: Puppy Pose
exercises.description: From all fours, walk the hands forward and melt the chest down with hips high.

exercises.name: Tree Pose
exercises.description: Balance on one leg with the other foot on the inner leg and arms up.

exercises.name: Mountain Pose
exercises.description: Stand evenly with arms at your sides and a long spine.

exercises.name: Boat Pose
exercises.description: Balance on your sit bones with legs lifted and arms forward.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Run in place, driving each knee to hip height.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.description: Jog lightly, bringing heels toward your glutes.

exercises.name: A-Skip
exercises.description: Skip forward with a rhythmic knee drive and a quick step down.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.description: Rise onto your toes and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bridge
exercises.description: On your back with one leg lifted, bridge up through the planted foot.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description: Lunge forward, stepping through into the next rep.

exercises.name: Strides
exercises.description: Accelerate smoothly to fast, relaxed running, then ease off.

exercises.name: Hill Sprint
exercises.description: Sprint hard up a short hill and walk back down.

exercises.name: Easy Jog
exercises.description: Jog at a pace where you could hold a conversation.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.description: Holding support, swing one leg forward and back.

exercises.name: Walking Knee Hug
exercises.description: Step and pull the opposite knee to your chest, rising onto your toes.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
exercises.description: Lean into a wall with one heel pressed back.
